whyRightActivity.title: Why Your Business Activity Matters
whyRightActivity.paragraph1: Your business activity determines your license type, visa quota, office requirements, and tax obligations. Choosing the wrong one can limit your growth.
whyRightActivity.paragraph2: Some activities require specific approvals — like media, healthcare, education, or financial services. We help you navigate the compliance.
whyRightActivity.paragraph3: We also ensure your activity list is flexible enough to support future expansion — so you don't need new licenses every time you grow.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about business activities in UAE free zones.

items.q: How do I choose the right business activity for my free zone company?
items.a: We match your business model, revenue streams, and long-term goals to approved activities across 30+ free zones. We also check licensing requirements, visa eligibility, and future scalability.

items.q: Can I register multiple activities under one license?
items.a: Yes — many free zones allow multiple related activities under one license. We help structure your license to cover all your revenue streams without needing new approvals.

items.q: Are all business activities allowed in every free zone?
items.a: No. Each free zone has its own approved activity list. For example, DSO is tech-focused, Dubai CommerCity is e-commerce-focused, and DMC is media-focused. We help you pick the right zone for your activity.

items.q: Do I need special approvals for regulated activities?
items.a: Yes. Activities like media, healthcare, education, and financial services require extra approvals from relevant authorities. We handle the entire approval process for you.

items.q: Can I change my business activity later?
items.a: Yes — most free zones allow activity amendments and additions. We handle the process for you so you stay compliant and flexible as you grow.

items.q: How long does it take to register a business activity?
items.a: Typically 3-7 working days depending on the free zone, activity type, and whether regulatory approvals are required.

items.q: What documents do I need to register a business activity?
items.a: Standard documents include passport copies, passport-size photos, proof of address, and a business plan for regulated activities. We guide you through every document.

items.q: How much does it cost to register a business activity in a free zone?
items.a: Costs vary based on the free zone, activity type, license, and visa requirements. Contact us for a personalized quote — we offer transparent pricing with no hidden fees.
